B62=np.array([[int(x) for x in l.split()] for l in """4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3

-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1

-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2

-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4""".strip().split("\n")],dtype=np.float32)
idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAS)}; NEG=np.float32(-1e9)
def encode(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,-1) for c in s],dtype=np.int32)
def nw_affine(a,b,go=11.0,ge=1.0):
    ai,bi=encode(a),encode(b); n,m=len(a),len(b)
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG,np.float32); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG,np.float32); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG,np.float32)
    ptrM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); ptrIx=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); iysrc=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int32)
    M[0,0]=0.0; jj=np.arange(m+1,dtype=np.float32); ii=np.arange(n+1,dtype=np.float32); ar=np.arange(m+1)
    Iy[0,1:]=-go-ge*(jj[1:]-1); Ix[1:,0]=-go-ge*(ii[1:]-1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        pm,px,py=M[i-1,:-1],Ix[i-1,:-1],Iy[i-1,:-1]
        best=np.maximum(np.maximum(pm,px),py)
        src=np.where(pm>=np.maximum(px,py),0,np.where(px>=py,1,2)).astype(np.int8)
        c=ai[i-1]; sub=(B62[c][np.clip(bi,0,19)] if c>=0 else np.full(m,-1,np.float32))
        sub=np.where(bi>=0,sub,-1).astype(np.float32)
        M[i,1:]=best+sub; ptrM[i,1:]=src
        ox=M[i-1,:]-go; ex=Ix[i-1,:]-ge
        Ix[i,:]=np.maximum(ox,ex); ptrIx[i,:]=(ex>ox).astype(np.int8)
        f=M[i,:]-go+ge*(jj+1); run=np.maximum.accumulate(f)
        Iy[i,0]=NEG; Iy[i,1:]=(run[:-1]-ge*jj[1:]).astype(np.float32)
        iysrc[i,:]=np.maximum.accumulate(np.where(f>=run,ar,0))
    endv=[M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]]; state=int(np.argmax(endv)); score=float(max(endv))
    i,j=n,m; A=[];Bb=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: A.append('-');Bb.append(b[j-1]);j-=1;continue
        if j==0: A.append(a[i-1]);Bb.append('-');i-=1;continue
        if state==0: A.append(a[i-1]);Bb.append(b[j-1]);s=int(ptrM[i,j]);i-=1;j-=1;state=s
        elif state==1: A.append(a[i-1]);Bb.append('-');nx=int(ptrIx[i,j]);i-=1;state=1 if nx==1 else 0
        else:
            k=int(iysrc[i,j-1])
            while j>k: A.append('-');Bb.append(b[j-1]);j-=1
            state=0
    return score,''.join(reversed(A)),''.join(reversed(Bb))
def tgt_cols(x,y):
    ia=0; col={}
    for p,q in zip(x,y):
        if p!='-': ia+=1; col[ia]=q
    return col
def pidf(x,y):
    ident=sum(1 for p,q in zip(x,y) if p==q and p!='-'); ncol=sum(1 for p,q in zip(x,y) if p!='-' and q!='-')
    return 100.0*ident/max(ncol,1)
def fetch(q,size=500,fields="accession,id,protein_name,organism_name,length,sequence"):
    url=f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query={requests.utils.quote(q)}&fields={fields}&format=tsv&size={size}"
    r=requests.get(url,timeout=180); r.raise_for_status()
    L=r.text.rstrip("\n").split("\n"); h=L[0].split("\t")
    return pd.DataFrame([dict(zip(h,l.split("\t"))) for l in L[1:] if l.strip()])

GROUPS={"GalE\n5.1.3.2":("NDP-sugar 4-epimerase","(ec:5.1.3.2)"),
        "Gne\n5.1.3.7":("NDP-sugar 4-epimerase","(ec:5.1.3.7)"),
        "HldD\n5.1.3.20":("NDP-sugar 6-epimerase","(ec:5.1.3.20)"),
        "RmlB\n4.2.1.46":("NDP-sugar 4,6-dehydratase","(ec:4.2.1.46)"),
        "Gmd\n4.2.1.47":("NDP-sugar 4,6-dehydratase","(ec:4.2.1.47)"),
        "Fcl\n1.1.1.271":("other NDP-sugar","(ec:1.1.1.271)"),
        "Uxs\n4.1.1.35":("other NDP-sugar","(ec:4.1.1.35)"),
        "DFR\n1.1.1.219":("nucleotide-independent","(ec:1.1.1.219)"),
        "CCR\n1.2.1.44":("nucleotide-independent","(ec:1.2.1.44)"),
        "3b-HSD\n1.1.1.145":("nucleotide-independent","(ec:1.1.1.145)")}
rows=[];cols={}
for lbl,(grp,q) in GROUPS.items():
    d=fetch(f"{q} AND (reviewed:true)")
    d=d[d["Sequence"].str.len().between(250,450)]
    for _,r in d.iterrows():
        sc,x,y=nw_affine(TARGET,r["Sequence"])
        rows.append(dict(acc=r["Entry"],panel=lbl,group=grp,score=sc,pid=pidf(x,y)))
        cols[(r["Entry"],lbl)]=tgt_cols(x,y)
    time.sleep(0.1)
R=pd.DataFrame(rows); R.to_csv("bll6421_panel_scores.csv",index=False)
print(R.groupby(["group","panel"]).agg(n=("score","size"),score_med=("score","median"),pid_med=("pid","median")).round(1).to_string())

# FdeJ
fdeJ=fetch("(accession:D8J0X4)").iloc[0]["Sequence"]
